classification.difficultyReason: Construct and measure three rays, identify which ray lies between the others in the student's own drawing, and select the two adjacent angles whose sum gives the outer angle.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In your exercise book, place $O$ to the left of your page. Allow at least $10\text{ cm}$ of space above, below and to the right of point $O$.

answer.short: Point $O$ placed with the required space.
answer.worked: Place $O$ towards the left of the exercise-book page, leaving at least $10\text{ cm}$ above, below and to its right.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw three rays, $OA$, $OB$ and $OC$, going off to the right in different directions.

answer.short: Three differently directed rays from $O$, all extending to the right.
answer.worked: Sample construction: draw $OA$ horizontally to the right, $OB$ at $30^{\circ}$ above $OA$, and $OC$ at $80^{\circ}$ above $OA$. Other orders and directions are valid.

spec.description: Authored sample solution, not a supplied source figure. Three rays extend rightwards from O, with OB between OA and OC.
spec.mathematics: The sample directions are 0, 30 and 80 degrees from the positive horizontal.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; the student question supplies no figure or angle values.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Using your protractor, measure the sizes of $\angle AOB$, $\angle BOC$ and $\angle AOC$.

answer.short: Answers depend on the drawing. For the sample: $\angle AOB=30^{\circ}$, $\angle BOC=50^{\circ}$ and $\angle AOC=80^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: Centre the protractor at $O$ and align its baseline with an arm of each angle. Read the scale starting at that arm. For the sample construction, the measurements are $\angle AOB=30^{\circ}$, $\angle BOC=50^{\circ}$ and $\angle AOC=80^{\circ}$.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Check that they obey the statement, ‘Adjacent angles can be added’.

answer.short: For the sample, $30^{\circ}+50^{\circ}=80^{\circ}$. The two adjacent smaller angles add to the larger angle.
answer.worked:
For the sample, $OB$ lies between $OA$ and $OC$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+\angle BOC&=30^{\circ}+50^{\circ}\\\angle AOB+\angle BOC&=80^{\circ}\\\angle AOB+\angle BOC&=\angle AOC.\end{align*}$$
For another valid drawing, identify the middle ray first. The two angles on either side of it add to the angle between the outer rays, allowing for measurement error.
